articles.summary: Putting your affairs in order, especially as you or loved ones approach their golden years, can provide peace of mind, rather than leaving you worried about unfinished financial affairs. After all, no one wants to leave unpaid bills, unanswered questions, or a disorganized mess for their children and loved ones to sort through.
articles.title: Getting Your Affairs in Order: 5 things to do before you die
